title: Python Learning Studio Ultra: An Interactive Python and Computational Civil Engineering Learning Environment
description: Python Learning Studio Ultra is a Persian-first interactive environment for learning Python programming, scientific computing, and computational civil engineering. It includes Monaco Editor, browser-based Python execution with Pyodide, NumPy, Matplotlib, automated exercises and tests, multi-stage quizzes, XP/Level/Achievement mechanics, civil-engineering computational examples, text-to-speech support, PWA functionality, and cross-platform packaging workflows.
